<!-- pr-reviewer: bcafadc780d213c70dae969a517ee162e3edcae7 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `set_part_axes` now builds `AlignPartToSetup::align_from_axes`, the same undoable command the Setups page queues, so MCP and GUI agree (`crates/app/src/mcp/align_tools.rs`). One axis keeps the in-plane turn and `turn_deg`; two axes give `frame: "full_3d"` with `turn_deg: null`. One undo step.
- Pinning test `mcp_align_axes` covers the full frame, the left-handed pair, undo in one step, the one-axis path and the parallel-picks refusal by name. It has a Gate map and sits in the right crate.
- Process change handled: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 46 (main is 45). Decision file `docs/decisions/1329-mcp-align-from-axes.md` is present. The skill row and tool description are updated.
- No unwrap, expect or panic on the new path, and no new dependency.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main, clean merge)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_align_axes`: 1 passed
- `--test mcp_setup`: 8 passed
- `--test align_axes`: 9 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test mcp_align_axes --test mcp_setup --test align_axes -- -D warnings`: clean
- The `coarse_rims.rs` break (#1349) did not occur: main already carries the fix.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Behaviour change for MCP callers: a left-handed pair was refused before and now lands, as in the GUI. The PR body and decision file say so.
- The follow-up the PR names (re-applying the same two-axis picks is not refused as already held, because of float noise) is fair as a separate issue.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: bcafadc780d213c70dae969a517ee162e3edcae7 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.23 (82k tokens)

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 82k | ~$0.23 |

Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Effort: effort:high
